concerns.text: FR-002 (Symbolic Planner) and SC-003 (Validity of symbolic approach) lack a dedicated implementation task. While T013 implements the planner, it is tagged [US2] and depends on T019d (exclusion logger) which is also [US2]. There is no explicit task in Phase 0 or Phase 1 to implement the core 'Symbolic Planner' logic (constraint parsing to sub-goals) as a standalone unit before the BES loop (US2) is built, leaving the foundational requirement FR-002 uncovered by a specific task.

FR-004 (Record success rate and cost) and SC-002 (Energy measurement) rely on T029b-impl (cost calculator) and T029a-impl (stats). However, the TDP calibration pipeline (T008a, T008c) required to generate the 'calibrated_tdp.json' artifact for energy calculation is marked as 'rejected' in the analyze report due to missing artifacts. No alternative task exists to measure energy or calculate cost without this specific calibration, leaving FR-004 and SC-002 unmeasurable.

SC-005 (Scalability/Complexity Class) requires characterizing the computational complexity class. While T029d-empirical and T029d-theory exist in Phase 5, there is no task in Phase 0 or Phase 1 to define the 'complexity_metric' mapping to asymptotic complexity in the data-model or research plan, which is a prerequisite for the empirical regression. The task T000c-impl claims to define this but depends on T000d-def (schema) which is ordered after it, creating a logical gap where the metric definition is not covered by a valid, executable task sequence.

Task T000c-impl is tagged as [P] and depends on T000d-impl, but T000d-impl depends on T000d-def. The dependency chain T000c-impl -> T000d-impl -> T000d-def is circular or logically inverted regarding the definition of 'complexity_metric' which T000c-impl claims to define before the schema (T000d-def) exists. This is a planning flaw where the task order does not support the requirement definition.

Task T029b-gpu-estimate references a 'known conversion factor' for GPU-hours but lacks a specific task to derive, validate, or record this factor in `data/`. This violates Constitution Principle IV (Single Source of Truth) as the baseline metric relies on an undefined external value not generated by a project task.
